notes:
Inbound via self-serve signup -> used free credits for a small pilot. Mobile-first social game (mid-core) looking to replace homegrown bot with LLM for in-room chat helpers + moderation. Wants hosted path; low ops overhead. Concise bullets from call: 
- "We need replies in under 200ms for short chat turns on mobile. Anything above 300ms feels laggy to players."
- Real-time chat, streaming responses, token cost sensitive but growth-stage willing to pay for low latency.
- Need robust abuse/spam controls: fast anti-spam signals + optional server-side moderation chain. Rate-limiting per-player and per-room.
- Prefers public cloud (GCP us-east, us-west) — no on-prem now.
- Interested in built-in content filters, webhook moderation events, and ability to run custom post-processing (lambda style).
- Wants SDK support: JS/Unity plugin and WebSocket example.
- POC idea: async moderation flow + streaming short replies to 100 concurrent players in a test lobby.
- Quote from PM: "We need something that degrades gracefully — if LLM is slow fall back to canned responses."
- Security: SSO for staff UI, audit logs for moderation actions, retention controls for chat transcripts (30-90d).
- Compliance: asked about SOC2; indicated they may require as they scale.
- Budget: early stage, forecast ~<$25k ARR first 12 months if pricing fits usage growth.
